name: Subscription Billing Console
description: Manage customer subscriptions, invoices, renewals and the recovery of failed payments
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read the public summaries; require auth for every subscription and invoice endpoint (any signed-in team member may read and change any subscription); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Subscription validation: customer_name is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; plan_name is one of starter, growth, enterprise; monthly_amount is a number above 0 and at most 100000 with at most two decimals; renewal_date is YYYY-MM-DD and, when created or changed, today or later; lifecycle_status is one of trial, active, past_due, cancelled (default trial); account_owner, when given, is at most 150 characters and defaults to the creator's username
PATCH /api/subscriptions/:id changes only the fields it is given, under the same rules; a cancelled subscription accepts no changes except back to trial or active

Invoices: POST /api/subscriptions/:id/invoices issues an invoice with amount_due (default the subscription's monthly_amount, above 0) and due_at (default 14 days after issue, not before the issue day); a cancelled subscription cannot be invoiced (409); a new invoice is open, with balance_remaining equal to amount_due and retry_state none

Collection attempts: POST /api/subscriptions/:id/retry records the outcome of one collection run over the subscription's open invoices; 'failed' adds 1 to each open invoice's retry_count (retry_state scheduled, or escalated from the third failure on), adds 1 to failed_payment_count and sets an active or trial subscription to past_due; 'succeeded' marks every open invoice paid (paid_at now, balance_remaining 0), resets failed_payment_count to 0 and, if the subscription was past_due, sets it to active and records recovered_at; without open invoices it changes nothing and answers 200 with retried 0

A subscription is delinquent when it is past_due or has an open invoice whose due_at has passed; churn_risk is high when it is past_due or failed_payment_count is 2 or more, medium when failed_payment_count is 1 or it is a trial renewing within 7 days, low otherwise, and null for cancelled subscriptions
MRR is the sum of monthly_amount over active and past_due subscriptions; trial and cancelled subscriptions do not count

GET /api/subscriptions returns active subscriptions, newest first; ?query= matches customer_name case-insensitively, ?lifecycle_status=, ?plan_name= and ?account_owner= filter exactly, ?delinquent=true keeps delinquent ones, ?sort= is one of -created_at (default), renewal_date, -monthly_amount, customer_name, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching subscription

GET /api/public/stats returns MRR, counts per lifecycle_status, the churn_risk breakdown, renewals in the next 30 days and recoveries in the last 30 days; GET /api/public/featured returns the five most recent recoveries

Deactivated subscriptions (is_active false) are left out of every list, summary and MRR and answer 404 on the subscription endpoints; the admin overview still lists them; subscriptions and invoices are never deleted

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for a change the subscription's state does not allow
frontend_requirements: Visitors see the landing page only, with a 'Sign in to open the console' prompt; signed-in team members get the subscription browser, details, dashboard and every edit, invoice and retry control
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Landing page: stat cards for MRR, active, trial and past-due subscriptions, renewals in the next 30 days, a churn-risk breakdown, and the recent recoveries from /api/public/featured

Subscription browser: lifecycle tabs, plan and owner filters, a 'delinquent only' switch, a customer search, sort controls and previous/next paging; each row shows customer, plan, monthly amount, renewal date, status, churn risk and an invoice-health indicator (open balance, failed payments)

Subscription detail: its fields with an edit form, the invoice history (issued, due, paid, amount due, balance, retry state) with an 'Issue invoice' form, and buttons to record a failed or successful collection run that show the updated invoices
Dashboard for the signed-in team member: their own accounts (?account_owner= with their username), split into upcoming renewals (?sort=renewal_date) and delinquent accounts with failed-payment alerts
Every form shows the API's validation messages next to the form
admin_requirements: Pricing overview: every subscription, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts, MRR, the number of delinquent accounts, the subscription count and MRR per plan and the churn-risk breakdown
Escalation queue: invoices whose retry_state is escalated (?retry_state=escalated), oldest due first, with the customer and balance; staff record further collection runs from the subscription detail
Toggle a subscription's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active subscriptions, searched, filtered, sorted and paged

query.lifecycle_status: One of trial, active, past_due, cancelled

api_endpoints.description: Change some of a subscription's fields; omitted fields keep their values
Invoice history of a subscription, newest first
Issue an invoice for a subscription
Record the outcome of a collection run over the subscription's open invoices
Aggregate billing figures for the landing page
The five most recent payment recoveries

data_models.name: Subscription
data_models.description: A customer's subscription; balance_remaining, delinquent and churn_risk are computed from it and its invoices

fields.lifecycle_status: string (one of: trial, active, past_due, cancelled; default trial)
fields.account_owner: string (optional, max 150 chars; default the creator's username)
fields.recovered_at: datetime (optional; set when a successful collection run ends past_due)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the subscription from lists, summaries and MRR)

data_models.name: Invoice
data_models.description: An amount billed to a subscription and its collection state

fields.status: string (one of: open, paid; default open)
fields.due_at: datetime (default 14 days after issued_at; not before the issue day)
fields.paid_at: datetime (optional; set when the invoice is paid)
fields.retry_state: string (one of: none, scheduled, escalated; default none)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin pricing overview: every subscription with revenue and risk metrics
Escalation queue: invoices filtered by retry state, oldest due first

query.retry_state: One of none, scheduled, escalated (default escalated)
